reviews.title: Lightweight, Simple, and Travel-Friendly Monitor
reviews.comment:
Absolutely Love This Monitor – Perfect for Work and Travel!
I can’t say enough good things about this monitor! It’s unbelievably lightweight and setting it up is a breeze—just one USB-C to C cable for both power and display. No extra cords, no hassle. The connection is instant, and the picture quality is crisp and vibrant. It’s not full HD, but honestly, it looks way better than any traditional monitor I’ve used.
The travel case included is a lifesaver. I take this monitor everywhere—coffee shops, offsite locations, even on trips—and the case keeps it safe and easy to carry. Plus, you get three cables (two USB-C to USB-C and one HDMI), so you’re covered for any setup.
The price? Totally reasonable for the quality and convenience you get. And the customer service was outstanding—quick, helpful, and friendly. This monitor has made my workflow so much smoother, and I can’t imagine going back. If you’re on the fence, don’t hesitate—grab this monitor. You’ll love it!
reviews.author: An N.

reviews.title: Excellent screen at a great price
reviews.comment: This is for the 2560x1600 Upperizon 16in monitor - it's fantastic!  Excellent image quality.  Gets very bright if you want it to.  You can choose the color space between P3, sRGB, Adobe RGB, and Native.  Native looks closest to my laptop screen and also close to P3.  Having an onscreen menu to choose color space and other settings is a huge bonus in a portable screen.  The resolution is excellent allowing large documents to be offloaded from my primary laptop screen.  My laptop is 1800 vertical, and this screen is 1600, which works well.  I didn't want a 16:9 HD display (only 1080 vertical), and this extra screen resolution is much more useful.  Very happy with this screen: it provides excellent imaging, portability and configurability in a lightweight and inexpensive package.
reviews.author: MG1

reviews.title: A great monitor for my purposes
reviews.comment: I bought this monitor to use with my Mac Mini on my roll top desk. Because of limits imposed by the desk, this was the largest monitor I could buy, so many conventional monitors would not fit. For me, it doesn’t matter. The monitor looks great, both in terms of sitting on my desk, and in terms of the video quality. It came with all the cables I would have needed, but in my case this was a very simple plug and play. It also came with a very nice, padded carrying case. I won’t be using it, but for someone who wants to take advantage of this monitor’s portability, it is a very nice touch. I have no way of knowing how long it is going to last in daily use, but so far I am very pleased. About the only downside is that the built in speakers are not very good. The sound quality is tinny and the volume is weak. My Mac Mini’s internal speakers are better, but I intend to add some external speakers to get even better volume. But the monitor’s speakers are a very minor issue. Overall, this is a good buy, IMHO.
reviews.author: Wayne P.

reviews.title: Larger screen - Huge Improvements!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1ucAGNx-0L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71NoODw7wXL._SY256.jpg I purchased the Upperizon Portable Monitor 10-inch monitor three years ago.  It was a breeze to setup for use as a third monitor for as my dedicated Chat screen.  Even back then- their customer service is PHENOMENAL The one complaint I had was the stand mechanism.  When approached to consider upgrading to the 18.5 inch, I declined because I had the smaller screen situated to prevent the monitor from slipping due to the flimsy stand. I was happy with it.
I contacted them last week about another 'issue' with the 10-inch that turned out to be my error.  I was asked to try the upgraded 18.5 inch.  They assured me improvements were made.  I agreed and ordered it yesterday.
I am SUPER happy I did.  The setup was a breeze - unplugged the old monitor. Plugged in the new one. Seamless. It booted up and automatically integrated with my setup.  The best part is the new stand.  It's perfect!  It's metal, firm and adjustable.  They actually listened to my complaint!
The monitor arrived well packaged, it has a nice carrying case with a pocket. For those of you looking for a sleek, lightweight, flexible travel monitor, this is the one for you.  For those of you still on the 10.5-inch monitor, it's time to upgrade.  You won't be disappointed.
